guidance.summary: Q3 results are not out until Oct 30, and no guidance changes were found in the window. The only item is a small pre-announced acquired IPR&D charge of about $0.18 per share.

evidence.claim: Regeneron pre-announced a Q3 acquired IPR&D charge of approximately $22 million pre-tax, reducing GAAP and non-GAAP EPS by approximately $0.18.
Regeneron will report third quarter 2026 financial results on October 30 before the U.S. market opens.

analyst_actions.summary: A broad wave of price-target raises came in during the window, including from Jefferies, Piper Sandler and Canaccord, plus a UBS upgrade to Buy with a $978 target. The rating is capped at +1 because all the sources are lower-tier.

evidence.claim: Jefferies raised its Regeneron price target to $930 from $870 and kept a Buy rating.
UBS upgraded Regeneron to Buy from Neutral and raised its price target to $978 from $660.
Piper Sandler maintained Overweight and raised its price target to $865 from $854.
Canaccord Genuity maintained Buy and raised its price target to $922 from $875.

litigation_regulation.summary: Regeneron settled its litigation with Sanofi as part of the expanded alliance, and the CHMP recommended an EU dosing update for Libtayo. The SDNY securities class action over fianlimab remains pending with no new ruling.

evidence.claim: The CHMP recommended EU approval of an updated Libtayo dosing regimen across all approved cancer types.
Sanofi and Regeneron settled their legal dispute as part of the expanded immunology deal.

customer_concentration.summary: The partnership with key partner Sanofi deepened: Sanofi will pay $1 billion upfront and up to $7 billion in milestones for new antibodies. Regeneron also extended its BARDA supply agreement for Inmazeb, and no customer losses were reported.

evidence.claim: Sanofi will pay Regeneron $1 billion upfront and up to $7 billion in milestones for four new long-acting antibodies, with profits shared 50:50.
Regeneron extended its BARDA agreement for additional supply of the Ebola treatment Inmazeb.

product_competitive.summary: The pipeline news was positive: the expanded Sanofi deal adds four long-acting immunology antibodies, garetosmab showed zero new lesions in FOP, and longer-term Libtayo C-POST data were presented at ESMO. Pressure on EYLEA from biosimilars remains background.

evidence.claim: Pasatru (garetosmab) showed zero new heterotopic ossification lesions in the OPTIMA extension in FOP.
The expanded alliance adds four long-acting antibodies targeting IL-13, IL-4xIL-13, IL-4 and IL-4Rα. The first, REGN20423, is in Phase 1 for atopic dermatitis.

writeup.headline: Regeneron rates Buy on a net-cash balance sheet, solid margins and strong price trend.
writeup.thesis: Regeneron scores 70, a Buy, driven mainly by a perfect balance sheet score of 100 (net cash, cash 4.02 times debt) and quality at 81, with a 24.7% operating margin, a 24.2% FCF margin and the diluted share count down 2.4% year on year. The trend score of 76 reflects the price 10.4% above its 200-day average, 4.5% below its 52-week high, and 9.7 pp ahead of SPY over the last 126 trading days. Growth is middling at 56: latest-quarter revenue growth of 16.7% year on year and TTM revenue growth of 9.3%, but growth slowed by 2.3 pp from the previous quarter. Valuation scores 58; in absolute terms multiples are moderate (4.9x sales, 20.3x FCF, 18.3x EV/EBIT) with the FCF yield 0.1 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield, and against its own history the stock sits near the middle of its own history. News risk at 66 is supported by the expanded Sanofi alliance, settled litigation with Sanofi and a wave of analyst target raises.
key_risks: Biosimilar pressure on EYLEA could weigh on revenue and margins.
Growth slowed by 2.3 pp from the previous quarter; further slowing would hurt the growth score.
Q3 results due Oct 30 could disappoint, and a small acquired IPR&D charge of about $0.18 per share is pre-announced.
The SDNY securities class action over fianlimab remains pending.
FCF yield 0.1 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield leaves little valuation cushion in absolute terms.
what_would_change: A drop of 6 points in the composite score would move the rating to Hold, for example from weaker trend or a negative news shift around Q3 results.
Reaching Strong Buy needs 10 more points, most plausibly from re-accelerating revenue growth lifting the growth score.
A pullback in the share price that leaves fundamentals intact could lift the valuation score but lower the trend score.
Adverse EYLEA biosimilar developments or litigation rulings would cut the news risk score.
